n4658b252fb.headline: Yen Staying Bearish after a Wild Ride; Dollar Index Presses Key Resistance
n4658b252fb.summary: The yen and Nikkei swung sharply after the Bank of Japan tweaked its Yield Curve Control, while yen crosses kept bullish trends. The dollar index pressed key resistance after three major central bank decisions.
n4658b252fb.why: The Bank of Japan's yield curve control policy anchors Japanese government bond yields, so changes to it move the yen and Japanese equities.
n4658b252fb.why_moved: The Bank of Japan's tweak to Yield Curve Control triggered a volatile reaction in the yen and Nikkei. Policy decisions by three major central banks also drove broader currency moves.
